externalDocs.description: llms.txt: endpoint guide, search syntax and field meanings

info.description: Items, abilities, monsters, maps, update notes, codes and Global Market prices from the official Vesteria Database, published by Vesteria, Inc.. Every HTML page also returns its data as JSON with `?format=json`. Money values are raw Mushcoin (1 Silver = 1,000; 1 Gold = 1,000,000; 1 Platinum = 1,000,000,000). Guide for agents: https://db.playvesteria.com/llms.txt
info.summary: Read-only JSON for the official Vesteria game database.
